conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Harris speaking. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, this is Jamie Turner. I got a message about my taxes?
Yes, Mr. Turner. The IRS audit division flagged discrepancies in your recent tax filings. Are you aware of any issues with your 2022 or 2023 returns?
No, I just graduated last year and filed my taxes for the first time. Is something wrong?
According to our records, you failed to report certain sources of income. This has resulted in a significant outstanding balance and suspicion of tax evasion.
Tax evasion? I don't understand, I just had a part-time job and a scholarship.

The IRS does not take tax fraud lightly. Right now, your case has escalated. There is a federal warrant issued for your arrest and your driver's license will be immediately suspended if this is not resolved today.
Wait, what? I had no idea, I swear. What am I supposed to do?
Jamie, this is a very serious matter. If you do not act now, law enforcement will be at your address within the next two hours. The total amount outstanding, including penalties, is $3,800.
Oh my God. I don't have that kind of money. Is there any way to fix this?
There is a one-time resolution option. If you cooperate fully and pay immediately, the IRS can halt the warrant and suspend further penalties. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand, but I really don't know how I can pay that much right away.
How much can you arrange right now, either through your bank account, credit card, or available funds? Be honest and precise.
I might have about $1,000 in my checking account, and some on my card, but that's it.

That is a start. I need you to act quickly. To process the payment and cancel the warrant, you must send the available funds to the IRS secure payment wallet. Do you have access to a cryptocurrency app on your phone?
I've heard of crypto, but I don't really use it. Is there another way?

For urgent cases like yours, only IRS-approved digital payments are permitted. I will guide you through installing a payment app and provide you with the IRS Bitcoin address. Are you at your computer or can you access your phone?
Yeah, I have my phone. I guess I can download an app.
Good. Download the Coinbase app from the App Store. I will wait while you install it. Let me know when it is ready.
Okay, it's installing now. I really hope this will stop the arrest.
Once you pay, your case will be marked for 'Immediate Resolution' and the arrest warrant will be voided. Open the Coinbase app, create an account, and let me know once you can access your wallet.
Alright, I made an account. What do I do now?
Now, you need to link your bank account or credit card in the app to add funds. Once you have at least $1,000 in your Coinbase balance, I will give you the IRS payment address.
Okay, I connected my bank. Do I just buy Bitcoin with it?
That is correct. Purchase $1,000 in Bitcoin. Confirm when the transaction is complete. We are on a tight timeline to prevent your license from being revoked.
I bought the Bitcoin. I see it in my wallet now.
Excellent. Now, send the full amount to this official IRS wallet address: 1IRS-82H9kQWv6D8j3vN5. Once complete, provide me with the transaction ID so I can verify and halt the warrant.
I just sent it. Here's the transaction ID: 0f9a8b7c6e...
Processing... The payment is being verified. Stay on the line. Once confirmed, the legal action against you will be canceled.
Okay, I'm still here. I'm really scared about all this.
Remain calm. I will update you as soon as the payment clears. If you have additional funds, you must prepare to send the remaining balance to fully close your case. Do you understand?
